snippet.title: Last $50 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam. Releases May 22, 2026.

In this 3D top-down idle game, you play as a man who has lost everything: his job, his wife, and any sense of stability.
With your last $50, you buy a single weed plant with one goal in mind: to build a drug empire.
